blocks.text: Across the world, populations are growing older. Japan is the best known example, where a large share of residents is past 65 and some rural towns are made up mostly of seniors. Italy and Germany are not far behind, as falling birth rates and longer lives reshape their cities. South Korea is aging faster than almost any country in history, and China is following the same path on a vast scale. The Philippines is still a young country, but that is changing.
